plain_english_policy: Restructure the electric utility industry to allow consumers to choose their power company.

effects.rationale: Restructuring the electric utility industry to allow consumers to choose their power company may lead to a decrease in environmental protection regulations, as utilities might prioritize profit over conservation efforts.

Allowing consumers to choose their power company could potentially increase the development of renewable energy sources and more efficient use of resources, which aligns with conservation preservation principles.

evidence_quote: "Restructure the electric utility industry to allow consumers to choose their power company." - Source: Year: 1998, Section: Environment & Energy, Question: Indicate which principles you support (if any) regarding the environment and energy. Option: h)
review_reason: The policy statement is vague on its environmental impact, as it does not specify whether this restructuring would lead to increased or decreased conservation preservation efforts.
